notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote-page metadata collection is implemented.
REF-BM-03: Manually entered titles can be edited before and after saving, but descriptions and auto-collected metadata are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, and tags are editable; description and note fields are absent.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title and tags but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and URL, plus tag names, but description and note are absent.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: There is no action to mark a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No bulk action can target the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to creation-date descending order; users cannot select a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshot preservation is absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
